sections.title: 1. General Provisions
paras: 1.1. This Agreement is a public offer in accordance with Articles 386–399 of the Civil Code of the Kyrgyz Republic.
1.2. The Contractor is a legal entity/sole proprietor providing online access to a service for generating digital content (images, audio, text) using neural networks.
1.3. The Customer is any individual who accepts the offer by registering on the Website and/or paying for the services.
1.4. The Website is the Contractor’s online platform available at: vokalo.ru, vokalo.kg, vokalo.online.
1.5. Personal Account is a secure section of the Website available after the Customer’s registration.

sections.title: 2. Subject of the Agreement
paras: 2.1. The Contractor provides the Customer with access to the platform’s functionality for generating digital content (images, text, audio), as well as related services.
2.2. The Customer undertakes to pay for access under the terms set out in this Agreement.

sections.title: 3. Procedure for Concluding the Agreement
paras: 3.1. The Agreement is deemed concluded from the moment of acceptance — payment for the services or registration in the Personal Account.
3.2. Acceptance means consent to all terms without limitations or reservations.
3.3. The fact of acceptance is the payment for a subscription or a one-time service package, including automatic recurring debits during auto-renewal.

sections.title: 4. Services
paras: 4.1. Access to services for generating images, text, and audio.
4.2. Access to templates, generation history, and additional services.
4.3. Technical support by e-mail: {{email}} during business hours.

sections.title: 5. Rights and Obligations of the Parties
paras: The Contractor undertakes:
— to ensure access to the platform during the paid period;
— to correct failures and errors at its own expense;
— to refund payments in the cases provided for by this Agreement.
The Contractor has the right:
— to change rates and service functionality;
— to temporarily suspend operations for maintenance;
— to change the service rules without prior approval from the Customer by publishing the current version on the Website.
The Customer undertakes:
— to pay for the services on time;
— to use the service only for lawful purposes and not violate third-party rights;
— to keep access credentials confidential and not share them with third parties.

sections.title: 6. Fees and Payment Procedure
paras: 6.1. Fees are determined by the rates published on the Website.
6.2. Payment is made by 100% prepayment: bank cards (VISA, MasterCard, Elcart), e-wallets, as well as via automatic recurring debits.
6.3. The subscription renews automatically; the Customer agrees to regular recurring debits.
6.4. The payment date is the date the funds are credited to the Contractor’s account.

sections.title: 7. Refunds and Subscription Cancellation
paras: 7.1. Full terms are set out in Appendix No. 1 ‘Payment and Refund Rules’.
7.2. A refund is possible if the service is not provided due to the Contractor’s fault, or if the Customer requested cancellation before the service begins.
7.3. If cancellation occurs after the service has started, a partial refund or no refund is made.
7.4. Subscription cancellation is performed in the Personal Account; funds debited for the current period are non-refundable.

sections.title: 8. Liability of the Parties
paras: 8.1. The Contractor is not liable for internet connectivity disruptions, actions of banks and payment systems, or the Customer’s subjective expectations regarding the neural network’s operation.
8.2. If the Customer violates the Agreement, the Contractor may suspend access without a refund.

sections.title: 9. Intellectual Property
paras: 9.1. All platform materials (code, interfaces, databases) belong to the Contractor.
9.2. Content generated by the User belongs to the User; however, the Contractor has the right to use it in anonymized form to demonstrate the service’s capabilities and for marketing.

sections.title: 10. Privacy and Data
paras: 10.1. The User consents to the processing of personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
10.2. Bank card details are not stored on the Contractor’s servers.

sections.title: 11. Force Majeure
paras: 11.1. The Parties are released from liability in circumstances of force majeure.

sections.title: 12. Final Provisions
paras: 12.1. The Agreement enters into force upon acceptance and remains effective until the end of the paid period.
12.2. The Contractor may amend the terms by publishing a new version on the Website.
12.3. Disputes are resolved through negotiations, and if unresolved — in court in accordance with the laws of the Kyrgyz Republic.

appendix.title: Appendix No. 1 — Payment and Refund Rules
paras: Services are paid non-cash (VISA/MasterCard/Elcart cards, e-wallets).
By choosing a subscription, the Customer agrees to automatic regular debits (recurring payments).
Refunds are possible:
100% — if the service was not provided due to the Contractor’s fault;
50% — if cancellation occurs within 30 days after service activation;
0% — if cancellation occurs after 30 days of the paid period.
Refunds are made to the account from which the payment was made, within up to 30 days.
